sources: MemGPT: Towards LLMs as Operating Systems
routes.projection: A finite LLM context can be treated as fast working memory backed by larger external state with explicit movement/compaction rather than as the whole agent memory.
routes.rakl_absorption: Separate the immutable epistemic archive from a compiled operation-specific working context; do not require the model to remember the archive.

sources: RAPTOR: Recursive Abstractive Processing for Tree-Organized Retrieval
routes.projection: Hierarchical summaries/navigation can retrieve across abstraction levels while retaining access to fine-grained source material; recent work explicitly targets minimal sufficient context under constrained budgets.
routes.rakl_absorption: Build regenerable multi-resolution views whose compact nodes point back to exact canonical records; context starts coarse and rehydrates only where authority/detail requires it.

routes.projection: Long retrieved contexts contain substantial redundancy. Query-conditioned or task-aware selection/compression can reduce token/latency costs, and compressing all available information is not necessarily optimal.
routes.rakl_absorption: Perform epistemic/task selection before optional textual compression; compression is a projection and must preserve rehydration/evidence pointers.

sources: ContextBudget: Budget-Aware Context Management for Long-Horizon Search Agents
routes.projection: Context management can be formalized as a decision problem under an explicit budget rather than an after-the-fact truncation step.
routes.rakl_absorption: Make context budget a registered operation constraint and return CANNOT_COMPILE when epistemically mandatory material cannot fit.

sources: MemGym: a Long-Horizon Memory Environment for LLM Agents
routes.projection: Memory quality can be evaluated separately from general reasoning/tool competence, reducing attribution confounds.
routes.rakl_absorption: Benchmark context/memory policy as its own fiber with matched model/tool/task conditions before claiming whole-system gains.

sources: Letta/Letta Code releases and memory-first architecture
routes.projection: Production stateful-agent systems encounter context inflation, compaction, stale recompile and memory rendering problems in practice; memory/context engineering is a continuing systems concern rather than solved by increasing nominal context windows.
routes.rakl_absorption: Treat context compilation, recompile identity and compaction/reconstruction as explicit engineering fibers with telemetry and regression tests.

not_counted_as_novel: content-addressed storage or materialized views generally
candidate_novelty_question: Whether explicit epistemic mandatory sets, negative-history/authority guards, reconstructable erasure-bearing compact views and fail-closed scientific context compilation constitute a distinct useful control layer when integrated with RAKL's atlas and authority system.
empirical_falsifier: If matched simpler context baselines preserve the same required evidence, negative history and downstream decisions at equal or lower cost, RAKL must not claim added value for the richer compiler.
